name: Organic contributor breadth breakout
hypothesis: Buy momentum only after deduplicated contributor breadth rises and net purchasing confirms it.
spec: Setup: More distinct established contributors may differ from repeated promotional posts. Entry: Buy momentum only after deduplicated contributor breadth rises and net purchasing confirms it. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on contributor concentration or price invalidation. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable.
